title: The Twist: one field from quantum gravity (UFE / Spiral Twist)
author: Danny Lee Eldridge
status_scope: Locked results as of 7 Nov 2026 (source of truth: CURRENT_MODEL.md). Every number comes from a rule locked before its data; failures are listed at the same size. Run status below is updated by hand, not live.
summary: The Barbero–Immirzi (BI) field from loop quantum gravity, written in supergravity, is a pair: a dilaton (a size) and an angle (a direction), tied together by fixed geometry (λ = −2√(2/3)). It couples to gravity through the Nieh–Yan term, which fixes the angle's width F = 1.559 and a cosine shape. Early on, the angle gives a short energy boost near matter–radiation equality (the Locked Twist); today, the dilaton rolls slowly as dark energy (the Spiral). Whether ONE field does both is being tested now (UB-1).
data: Planck 2018, ACT DR6, SPT-3G D1, DESI DR2 BAO; Pantheon+, DES-Dovekie, Union3, DES Y5 supernovae; DES Y6 / KiDS weak lensing

fits.label: Locked Twist (early role, CAMB, same data)

result_lines: Spiral (late role) vs ΛCDM: Δχ² −9.22 / −11.44 / −12.88 on Pantheon+ / Dovekie / Union3 — BEATS ΛCDM
Spiral vs w0–wa: +0.73 / +1.80 / +2.12 — COMPETITIVE, not better
Quantum width F = 1.559 fixed (TF-P): SUPPORTED on DES Y5; Union3 disfavoured, Pantheon+ consistent
Locked Twist (early role) vs ΛCDM: −4.70 Planck, −7.23 blind P-ACT, −4.55 / −5.08 / −4.91 three SN sets — pass
Locked Twist vs w0–wa on combined CMB: −5.63 vs −10.89 — LOSES
Weak lensing: simple S8 penalty a tie (2.87 / 0.75); full DES Y6 check OVER the limit for every version (2.86 to 6.97)
Failed and dropped: N = 9 width, silver-ratio angle, pure-torsion early width, β = 0.816, simple birefringence, running-F unification

fingerprint.title: A fingerprint only torsion has
fingerprint.equation: V(φ) = Λ⁴ [1 − cos(g(φ)/F)]³ ,  g(φ) ∝ sinh(φ/√(3/2) M_Pl + x₀)
fingerprint.text: In the torsion picture the natural dial is the Immirzi parameter γ itself. If the potential repeats in γ rather than in the field, it is lopsided in a way generic early dark energy is not. With the field's resting point fixed at loop quantum gravity's γ₀ ≈ 0.2375, it shifts the CMB acoustic angle by about 0.025% and the temperature spectrum by about 0.1%, right at Planck's precision. The fit's decision rule was written down before running.
